g.text: Follow printed terminal labels, not block positions.

g.desc: Follow printed terminal labels, not block positions.

g.text: Module wiring only; no physical footprint mapping.

g.desc: Module wiring only; no physical footprint mapping.

g.text: Switch is ON/OFF, not safety isolation.

g.desc: Switch is ON/OFF, not safety isolation.

g.text: RUN: no computer USB; JP1 fitted; switch ON.

g.desc: RUN: no computer USB; JP1 fitted; switch ON.

g.text: Battery -> switch -> UBEC 5V -> servos AND ESP.

g.desc: Battery -> switch -> UBEC 5V -> servos AND ESP.

g.text: ESP branch: JP1 -> D1 -> ESP 5V header.

g.desc: ESP branch: JP1 -> D1 -> ESP 5V header.

g.text: PROGRAM: switch OFF; REMOVE JP1; then plug USB.

g.desc: PROGRAM: switch OFF; REMOVE JP1; then plug USB.

g.text: After programming: unplug USB, then refit JP1.

g.desc: After programming: unplug USB, then refit JP1.

g.text: D1 alone does NOT prevent PC backfeed; remove JP1.

g.desc: D1 alone does NOT prevent PC backfeed; remove JP1.

g.text: Never connect 2S pack directly to ESP 5V or BAT+.

g.desc: Never connect 2S pack directly to ESP 5V or BAT+.

g.text: All GND labels share ground. Use proper power wire.

g.desc: All GND labels share ground. Use proper power wire.

g.text: JP1: fitted to RUN; REMOVE before USB.

g.desc: JP1: fitted to RUN; REMOVE before USB.

g.text: Normal run: battery powers ESP + four SG90s | USB for programming only | Camera / mic / Wi-Fi retained

g.desc: Normal run: battery powers ESP + four SG90s | USB for programming only | Camera / mic / Wi-Fi retained

g.text: Main 2-wire lead: RED = pack +; BLACK = pack -.

g.desc: Main 2-wire lead: RED = pack +; BLACK = pack -.

g.text: Main lead supplies the switch / UBEC as drawn above.

g.desc: Main lead supplies the switch / UBEC as drawn above.

g.text: 3-wire BLACK / BLUE / RED plug = 2S balance lead.

g.desc: 3-wire BLACK / BLUE / RED plug = 2S balance lead.

g.text: Balance functions: pack -, cell midpoint, pack +.

g.desc: Balance functions: pack -, cell midpoint, pack +.

g.text: Wire-to-pin order is NOT verified: do not wire by colour.

g.desc: Wire-to-pin order is NOT verified: do not wire by colour.

g.text: Midpoint is NOT ground; never join it to GND.

g.desc: Midpoint is NOT ground; never join it to GND.

g.text: Unplug MAIN lead from robot before charging.

g.desc: Unplug MAIN lead from robot before charging.

g.text: Use a charger explicitly rated for 2S LiPo (8.4V full).

g.desc: Use a charger explicitly rated for 2S LiPo (8.4V full).

g.text: Balance plug -> charger 2S balance socket, after pin check.

g.desc: Balance plug -> charger 2S balance socket, after pin check.

g.text: Some chargers ALSO need main red/black charge leads;

g.desc: Some chargers ALSO need main red/black charge leads;

g.text: others charge through the balance plug alone.

g.desc: others charge through the balance plug alone.

g.text: Exact connections require charger model + plug photos.

g.desc: Exact connections require charger model + plug photos.

g.text: Do NOT use an unverified Adafruit 1S USB-C charger.

g.desc: Do NOT use an unverified Adafruit 1S USB-C charger.

g.text: ESP USB and UBEC do not charge this pack.

g.desc: ESP USB and UBEC do not charge this pack.
